title: Portable Skill Frontmatter Spec (PSFS) v1.1.0
description: Canonical, portable, tool-agnostic JSON Schema for SKILL.md frontmatter, conforming to the Portable Skill Frontmatter Spec (PSFS) v1.1.0 (see spec/PSFS.md). This schema expresses PER-FILE STRUCTURE ONLY: required fields, types, patterns, and enumerations for a single SKILL.md frontmatter object. CROSS-FILE checks are explicitly OUT OF SCOPE for JSON Schema and remain in scripts/lint-skills.sh: name uniqueness within the collection, name == directory name, and owns.directories non-overlap between role skills. Core fields (name, version, description plus Anthropic optionals) define Core conformance; the multi-agent extension fields define Extended conformance.

name.description: Skill identifier. Kebab-case, must match the skill folder name (folder match enforced by lint-skills.sh, not this schema).

description.description: Primary trigger text. No XML angle brackets ('<' or '>') — frontmatter loads into Claude's system prompt.

compatibility.description: Human-readable environment requirements. No angle brackets.

license.description: Per-skill license override. No angle brackets.

allowed-tools.description: Canonical: whitelist of tool names the skill may invoke.

allowed_tools.description: Deprecated alias of allowed-tools (underscore form). Accepted for back-compat; new skills should use allowed-tools.

argument-hint.description: Hint shown in Claude Code's slash-command UI for skills taking a positional argument. No angle brackets.

disable-model-invocation.description: When true, the skill is invocable only by an orchestrator or explicit slash-command, not Claude's normal auto-trigger.

metadata.description: Free-form attribution, cataloging, and integration metadata.

requires_agent_teams.description: Extended: true if the skill requires CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1.

requires_claude_code.description: Extended: true if the skill requires the Claude Code CLI (bash, filesystem access).

owns.description: Extended: ownership declaration for agent role skills. Cross-file non-overlap of owns.directories is enforced by lint-skills.sh, not this schema.

composes_with.description: Extended: other skill names this naturally works with (informational).

spawned_by.description: Extended: which skills spawn this one.
